documented_probe: C-e9521e76 (construct multi-hop SPARQL joins across several related resource types): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Conjunctive graph-pattern (SPARQL-like) join over a triple list. The main difficulty is correct join / consistency semantics: handling variables in arbitrary positions (subject/predicate/object), self-joins (chains), single empty binding for all-constant patterns, empty result vs empty-domain handling, and deterministic ordering (join_order first-occurrence, bindings sorted by variable names alphabetically). All this must generalize to hidden inputs the program is re-run on, so the solver must model variable-value domains and cross-product enumeration rather than match the one provided query. stdlib only, no network attached.
